The scaling works well for the recipe quantities (although it leaves some very odd numbers instead of just rounding), but does not scale anything in the recipe text example in a recipe scaled for four, it says to divide into three bowls The recipes are poorly edited, I wonder if AI had a hand in them. Ingredients appear in the text without being listed, it’s often unclear what needs to be done to an ingredient or it is introduced at an inconvenient time (put something in a hot pan, then chop onions) Such a shame, the three recipes I made were tasty, but they were harder to make than they should have due to poor instruction. title: Good idea, but haven’t been able to use it
body: I liked the concept of Mob, and got a trial membership to check out what the app looks like (can’t see it without signing up). When I logged back in to cancel it half an hour later, it said that I didn’t have a membership? I forgot to email the customer support that day which is totally my fault, but when I got charged and emailed them about a refund, they said it was against their policy. Worse, I thought I would be charged for a month but I got charged for an entire year of the membership. I was disappointed with the customer care but because it was largely my fault for not reaching out earlier, I understand. For the app itself, I started using it just because of the membership. While again, I love the concept, there a few things that make it unusable for me. I spent hours going through the recipies and finding the ones I like, but in the 2-3 weeks I have had the app, I could not cook any. In part, this is because each recipe needs a complete set of specialized ingredients which need to be bought. I wish they had substitutes because I donot want to buy “sambal oelek” for one Thai recipe, and “golden mountain seasoning sauce” for another. My pantry has a basic set of ingredients, and I would’ve appreciated suggested alternatives to the listed ingredients. The second thing that bothers me is the way quantities are mentioned. For example, how much is 3/4 oz basil leaves?? It would be helpful to have additional description for how much of the ingredient is required. In the end, I spent money on this app, more money on ingredients I didn’t need, spent time finding recipes, more time trying to understand the recipe, and ended up ditching the recipe completely and winging it because that is quicker. 2 stars because some recipes are nice, they have good ideas and overall concept is good. It’s just not usable for me.

body: I’ve actually enjoyed the recipes I’ve tried so far, but I had to cancel my subscription because I believe there’s other apps out there that do more for a lower cost. There’s a few things that could be updated that I would bring back to Mob if they implemented them. 1. I don’t consider a 20g of protein meal “high protein.” I think that this should be adjustable based on preference. 2. I wish I was able to filter by macros. It would be get if I could set a filter to be under X amount of calories, over X amount of protein, etc. This would save a lot of back in forth of having to open a recipe to check this. 3. When building a meal plan, it would also be nice if the app automatically populated breakfast, lunch, and dinner into completely separate fields. 4. I wish that the suggested recipes when creating a meal plan could factor in food waste, and told me what was leftover as I’m building it out. Ex: I used half an onion for this recipe, let’s use the other half in another one. It does this but only after the plan is built. 5. Building off the previous one, I wish that the meal plans could auto populate plan suggestions based on the above. 6. It would be handy if for certain items there were suggestions of substitutes. title: From a very critical home cook + full time software developer, absolutely incredible app!!
body: TL;DR - it’s an amazing recipe app. Just try it and ignore the critical reviews. I work full time as a software developer, and am also a mom to 2 littles and the main cook in our home. My husband and I value nutritious + delicious meals (it feels like so often you have to pick one of the other), and I’ve spent so many hours doomscrolling Pinterest trying to get out of our same recipe rut unsuccessfully, never finding enough recipes that meet our standards. I’ve got a freezer full of lamb meat that I now finally know how to use! 😄👍🏼 We also recently focused in on our budget more strictly, so I needed a way to figure out exactly which ingredients to buy so we don’t have waste and can spend wisely. I kept getting ads for this app on social media, and finally decided to give their free trial a go to see what kinds of recipes are on here. (Great ads btw, it’s very difficult to convince me to actually try something from an ad). I must say, I am blown away by the quantity and quality of the recipes on here! It’s like a treasure trove of recipes that finally meet all of our requirements and actually sound good! I just spent 20 minutes testing out all the functionality I would want to see in an app like this from a developer’s perspective, and it’s great. It provides all the functionality I want. Any app is going to have room for incremental improvements, so constructive feedback to the development team is always helpful. But so far I have zero complaints. I read some other critical reviews about US measurement conversions and that seems to be taken care of. Also, if you’re already versed in cooking, it’s not hard to swap an ingredient or 2 out in a recipe to customize it to what you already have on hand or to meet your tastes better. After scrolling this app for a while, I’ve also found that there are PLENTY of gluten free, dairy free and other recipe options for those with restrictions and it’s so easy to search/filter for absolutely anything that you want. I would honestly say ignore the negative reviews and give it a try. Very impressed with this app and will definitely be keeping the monthly subscription! If you need help formulating a grocery list or just recipe ideas, this app is 10x more helpful than Pinterest. Very worth the $9.99/month with how much time and mental energy it saves in cooking and meal planning, plus overspending at the grocery store. No, this review was not incentivized, I just really love this app and the problems it’s solving in my day to day. 😂😊

title: Love it!

title: Get it!
body: Definitely worth the money! Takes the thinking out of meal prep and dinners, and it has been such a huge help

title: Thank goodness for this app
body: I’ve needed this app for a long time. The recipes are creative, simple, delicious and full of different culture options. It takes all the work out of cooking and meal planning and allows me to make delicious food for several days for my family. I also love how you can filter on things like freezable meals and it will tell you the best way to reheat

title: I AM very much loving this app
body: I’ve recommended this app to SO many people. There are some insanely good recipes on it and I love the simplicity of it, that I don’t need a hundred ingredients for one recipe. I think one thing that really sold it for me was the “batch meals”, making one protein to use in a variety of recipes versus eating the same thing every day. Brilliant! The price point is worth it, the navigation is easy and user friendly, and the branding of showcasing several chefs and their series on IG is great. Well done

title: Great food
body: Amazing meals clearly design with taste and nutrition in mind.

title: Measure conversions?
body: Absolutely love these recipes! My only sheepish, humble request would be perhaps a toggle mode to measurements commonly used in the U.S., for us silly Americans? Obviously I can convert, but it’s a little time consuming for each new recipe.

title: It’s not all knowing. BUT!
body: It’s not all knowing. And that’s okay. This app feels like you’re grandma’s secret cookbook. It’s helped to fan my already curious flame of home cooking meals. I used ingredients that I never thought I would to create some hella good meals for myself and others . Also learning what can go together. To make a bold meal that’s always in rotation. It’s not all knowing but that’s okay; it may not have the ingredient you are looking to use in the meal as a base. But I do believe it looks past the basic. With the latest update to have built-in alternative ingredients is a god send. Love that it builds a grocery list. Adjust for the size of servings so you may get some leftovers. I encouraged you to hold off on the Grub Hub and enjoy time in the kitchen. This app will be your secret weapon.

title: Easy, healthy and fun
body: I’ve always loved cooking and mob just makes it better. Easier to for grocery shopping and planning, but also more fun to find new recipes and try new ingredients combinations. I mostly follow the recipe’s vibe, rather than the exact instructions - and it’s always yummy

title: Mob can save your marriage!
body: I honestly love this app so much. I use to never cook because I find the whole process overwhelming and I’d constantly mess up recipes. Mob makes it so simple with the grocery list, so I know (and have) exactly what I need. The recipes are clear and easy to follow. Plus, the functionality with ingredients included in the recipe steps is incredible. Maybe the best part is no need to endlessly scroll through ads to find the recipe (and no pop-up ads either!!). I’ve actually started to enjoy cooking and now cook 3-4 times a week…which has made my wife way happier 😅

title: It’s not free

title: Top notch recipes
body: Day 2 and the recipes continue to deliver. Agree with some app inconsistencies, but none have been a deal breaker. I’m in my free trial period, and still haven’t decided if I’ll continue but it will be a hard decision because of the price. I wish there were additional membership options.

title: Mob was worth having before the app, now it’s a MUST
body: I LOVE Mob. I initially followed a few of the recipes they posted on TikTok, was blown away by how flavorful the recipe was. I did a free trial subscription to try a few more, but I was instantly hooked. The app really delivers! It has an intuitive UX, I love the mean planning feature, and the way they make it easy to switch between ingredients and instructions (like NYT Cooking). Where they have NYT beat is the NUTRITION FACTS FOR EVERY RECIPE!! THANK YOU, MOB! I love you so much.

title: Favorite cooking app
body: I’ve always loved MOB and this app makes it so much easier to use it thank you so much

title: So easy to use
body: Mob is all about accessibility and easyness and this app is the epitome of that. So so easy to use and has made my life in the kitchen A LOT simpler.
